description: Full-text search of New York Times news articles. Returns headlines, abstracts, sections, bylines, and URLs. Example: search_articles({ query: "artificial intelligence", sort: "newest" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

begin_date.description: Earliest article date in YYYYMMDD format, e.g. "20240101" (optional).

page.description: Result page (0-indexed, 10 results per page). Default 0.

query.description: Search query — keywords or phrase to search New York Times articles for.

name: search_articles
title: Search Articles
